phase: Prompt 9.15 — Final UX, QR Attribution & Production Polish

issues.title: QR Lead Attribution Clarity
issues.before: Manager CRM displayed 'Source: Website Direct' for Area QR leads with only a visual 'Q' badge.
issues.after: Manager CRM displays 'Source: QR', 'Area: <AreaName>', 'QR ID: <qrId>', and 'Placement: <placementName>' across Lead Table, Drawer, and Customer 360.

issues.title: CEO Dashboard KPI Card Text & Currency Truncation
issues.before: Cards showed truncated headers ('TOTAL BO...', 'BOOKING V...') and clipped currency figures on 1024px/1280px widths.
issues.after: KPICard has truncate removed, uses text-wrapping with whitespace-normal, and responsive grid (grid-cols-2 md:grid-cols-3 xl:grid-cols-6) preventing card squeezing.

issues.title: Confusing CEO Business Terminology
issues.before: 'Booking Velocity Trajectory', 'Operational Risk Radar', 'Liquid Cash', 'Physical Nodes'.
issues.after: Simplified to 'Booking Growth', 'Urgent Alerts', 'Bank & Cash Balance', and 'QR Areas'.
issues.evidence: Verified across CEOCommandCenter.jsx, FinancialCommandStrip.jsx, and QRAnalytics.jsx.

issues.title: Manager AI-Off State Experience
issues.before: Generic 'AI Help is Currently Off' notice with empty action pane.
issues.after: Polished notice 'AI assistance is currently switched off by the CEO' with manual fallback actions ('Create Quote', 'Ask Customer via WhatsApp') without compromising CEO-only AI controls.
